b1-22-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Is She?
b1-22-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks where your sister Lauren is. She is not answering her phone. You guess she is at home, but you are not sure.
b1-22-01.prompt: Tell Carlos where you think Lauren is and that you are not sure.
cues: Say where you think she is
b1-22-01.target: Estará en casa, pero no estoy segura.
b1-22-01.english: She is probably at home, but I am not sure.
b1-22-01.canDo: I can use the future to make predictions and guesses.

b1-22-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Perhaps on Friday
b1-22-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks whether your brother Andreas will visit you in Budapest next week. You are not sure, but perhaps he will arrive on Friday.
b1-22-02.prompt: Tell Meg that perhaps Andreas will arrive on Friday and that you are not sure.
b1-22-02.target: Quizá llegue el viernes, pero no estoy seguro.
b1-22-02.english: Perhaps he will arrive on Friday, but I am not sure.
b1-22-02.canDo: I can express different degrees of probability.

b1-22-03.title: Communicative Challenge: With More Time
b1-22-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what you would do if you had more free time in Budapest. You would visit his grandmother in Madrid.
b1-22-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what you would do if you had more time.
b1-22-03.target: Si tuviera más tiempo, visitaría a tu abuela en Madrid.
b1-22-03.english: If I had more time, I would visit your grandmother in Madrid.
b1-22-03.canDo: I can describe hypothetical situations and their consequences.

b1-22-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Different Life
b1-22-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what life would be like if you both lived in Madrid, where your grandmother lives.
b1-22-04.prompt: Tell Meg what life might be like if you lived in Madrid.
b1-22-04.target: Si viviéramos en Madrid, quizá tendríamos una vida diferente.
b1-22-04.english: If we lived in Madrid, perhaps we would have a different life.
b1-22-04.canDo: I can imagine alternative future scenarios.

b1-22-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Blue Bird
b1-22-05.scenario: You are Meg. You read a retelling of a story by Rubén Darío for a class in Budapest. Carlos asks what happens in it.
b1-22-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what the poet Garcín says and what he does when his father writes to him.
cues: Say what Garcín says about a bird
Say what he does with his father's letter
b1-22-05.target: Un poeta llamado Garcín dice que tiene un pájaro azul en la cabeza. Su padre le escribe una carta, pero Garcín no acepta el trabajo.
b1-22-05.english: A poet called Garcín says he has a blue bird in his head. His father writes him a letter, but Garcín does not accept the job.
b1-22-05.canDo: I can make predictions using evidence and trends.

b1-22-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Prices Next Year
b1-22-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks you what will happen to prices in Budapest next year. The trend says they will rise, but you are not sure.
b1-22-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what the trend says and that things may change.
b1-22-consolidation.target: Según la tendencia actual, los precios subirán, aunque es posible que cambie la situación.
b1-22-consolidation.english: According to the current trend, prices will rise, although the situation may change.
